# Jensen Huang satte dagsordenen - men er det nok til at holde investorerne tilfredse?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-11-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Millionærklubben episode is mostly about Nvidia's 30%+ jump after Jensen Huang returned as CEO, which the panel ties to Trump stepping in. Host-guest Lars Svendsen calls it a bubble and a 'Trump-put', and guest Jan Widersø warns that it damages trust in the US. Both are bearish on US equities over the long run. The second half covers Jan's Danish stock picks: Netcompany is a strong buy (fair value over 500), Pandora is a buy (fair value about 1200), and he has trimmed Carlsberg to take profit. Lars explains his long oil positions and his BW LPG holding.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NETC — Netcompany | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Guest Widersø (Panorama Invest) owns it: fair value over 500 vs about 350, P/E about 20 this year and about 15 for 2027, platform and royalty model, strong management.

#### Reasoning

Guest view. Mission-critical public and private software built on reusable locked platforms gives a competitive edge in bids plus high-margin royalties. Revenue is moving to about 70% service, which makes cash flows more predictable. Foreign units grow fastest (UK +45% over two years) and acquisitions are sensibly priced. EBITDA margin is near the 20% target. Host-guest Svendsen is sceptical because of public-sector dependence.

#### Sell Triggers

- if project execution slips
- major outage or hack in critical systems
- if AI turns its software into a commodity
- if management quality or capital allocation gets worse

> *"vi mener, at den er over 500 hver. Det gør vi på baggrund af penge, pengestrømte analyser."*

---

### 🟢 PNDORA — Pandora | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Widersø's conservative fair value is about 1200 vs 926.40; about 80% gross margin; Phoenix strategy to grow beyond charms (17% of the jewellery market).

#### Reasoning

Guest view. High margins and return on capital, a professional board (Peter Ruzicka), data-driven marketing, and room to grow outside charms. Platinum-plated pieces offset the silver price spike. Ranked below Netcompany because of the CEO change (early days) and a history of losing focus when broadening.

#### Sell Triggers

- poor quarterly execution under the new CEO
- losing focus on Moments / repeating the 2017-19 broadening mistakes
- silver costs keep squeezing margins
- price cuts or promotions

> *"vi mener, at Pandora er en god investering, men vi mener, at Netcompany er en bedre investering"*

---

### 🟡 CARL-B — Carlsberg | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Panorama sold two-thirds at just over 1000 (bought at 700) and keeps the rest; conservative fair value 1200.

#### Reasoning

Guest view. The company performs exactly as it should, but higher rates, more competition, a flat beer market and weaker specialty beer in a downturn led to profit-taking. The remaining stake is kept because the stock is still below the 1200 conservative value.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates keep rising
- more competition
- if specialty beer weakens in a downturn
- price reaches about 1200

> *"Vi mener egentlig, at den er konservativt set 1200 værd."*

---

### 🟡 BWLPG — BW LPG | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Svendsen holds it; very strong report but the stock fell 2% to 213.6; he hopes it recovers by Christmas.

#### Reasoning

Host-guest Svendsen's view. LPG shipping is tied to more natural gas liquefaction, and the report was strong with more expansion ahead. He treats the sell-off on good news as a classic overreaction and expects a recovery.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the share price does not recover
- if the LPG shipping market weakens

> *"Ja, det var et meget flot regnskab."*

---

### 🟡 BP — BP | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Svendsen is long oil through BP, Petrobras and Eni; he expects a supply shortfall next year that should keep prices up.

#### Reasoning

Host-guest Svendsen's view, citing Frontline: inventories are too low, demand is about 104m barrels/day plus about 4m to refill stocks, so oil prices are unlikely to be low. He also says oil may peak.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil prices peak or supply rises sharply
- if the US pushes up OPEC supply

> *"Jeg har jo tre, som jeg nu husker, altså BP, Petrobras og Eni."*

---

### 🟡 PBR — Petrobras | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

One of Svendsen's three oil holdings; he expects a structurally tight oil market.

#### Reasoning

Host-guest Svendsen's view: tight supply and too-small inventories argue against low oil prices.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil prices peak or supply rises sharply

> *"Jeg har jo tre, som jeg nu husker, altså BP, Petrobras og Eni."*

---

### 🟡 ENI — Eni | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Svendsen holds it; its subsidiary Vår Energi is expanding strongly after buying ConocoPhillips North Sea fields.

#### Reasoning

Host-guest Svendsen's view: long oil in a tight market, and Eni's North Sea growth through Vår Energi stands out while peers cut back.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil prices peak or supply rises sharply

> *"Enis datter, VAR op i Norge ... har jo købt nu denne her Konoco Philips-felter i Nordsøen og udvider meget kraftigt"*

---

### 🟡 VWS — Vestas | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Panorama holds a small position and is satisfied with the latest report.

#### Reasoning

Guest Widersø mentioned only briefly that the fund has a small stake and is happy with the results; no thesis was given.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the investment thesis weakens in future reports

> *"Vestas har vi også en lille smule i. Så er vi godt tilfredse med regnskaberne."*

---
